hypothesis: Exact source-derived Bifid output, reproduced btcseed prefix/suffix, or complementary parity rails feed unresolved AES
justification: A source-keyed public recipe reproduces a concrete btcseed prefix and exact archived570-letter result. Testing its actual material as downstream passphrase is stronger than assuming letters imply a solution. Parity rails are explicit weaker yinyang alternatives; their alphabet restriction is algebraically forced.
limits: Plan only; no free Bifid key/period, second cipher, decoder alphabet, payload edit, arbitrary slice or brute-force dictionary. Prefix alone is not enough.
